parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The outer frame of the keyboard made of ABS plastic, providing structural support and housing for all keys.
parts.Functional_description: It holds all the keys and internal components in place, ensuring durability and rigidity.
parts.Movement_description: It is a static part and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Key
parts.Basic_description: A keycap made of ABS plastic, part of the keyboard’s input interface.
parts.Functional_description: It transmits user input to the underlying switch when pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.
